quest.title: A Bewildering Fate
quest.description: On your journey, you witness Mona's strength as an astrologist, as well as her constraints. At last, you arrive at your destination — Mondstadt.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x525, Primogem x60, Mora x31125, Teachings of Resistance x5, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Are you ready? Don't shame your master now — we're about to meet that successor.

choices.text: I can't tell fortunes...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I guess... Wait, no! It won't do if you have no idea at all, even if you are a fake disciple.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: We have a rule that forbids us from teaching outsiders, but I suppose... I suppose I could teach you.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: My astrology is based on hydromancy, and as the name suggests, I use the reflections in water bodies to observe the true starry sky.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Allow me to demonstrate. Watch closely now.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: From the present station and movement of the stars... I see, so that successor is a young... female... Knight of Favonius.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Doesn't that sound like... Lisa?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: We will meet her here presently.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Well, that's all the information we need.

choices.text: Th—That's all?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: *sigh* It seems that even basic astrology can't be grasped in one go.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Never mind. I'll explain in detail later — she's here.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Wow, it's you, {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight! And Paimon too! You're back!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: That's her! The successor to great knowledge!

choices.text: ...You mean Klee!?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Successor...?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: That's right. I am the astrologist who has plumbed the depths of the ocean of stars. Surely, you have long calculated my arrival as well.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: An ocean of stars? What's that? Does it have fish in it?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Fish...? No, don't play dumb. Is this some kind of game?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I should be the one saying that! I didn't get what you said at all!

choices.text: We're getting nowhere fast.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: But my predictions can't be mistaken... Well, let's make sure. Your mother's name is Alice, isn't it?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: That's right! Oh, so you're Mommy's friend! But she's gone very far away...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: My readings told me as much. But before she left, she must have imparted her mystical arts to you, surely?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Mystical... arts? I... don't get it. Mommy only taught me to make Jumpy Dumpties.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So Klee's mother is the friend and rival of Mona's teacher?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Yes. As well-versed in astrology as she was, my master knew only astrology. Alice, on the other hand, was skilled in a great many other mystical fields.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... Klee's so young, so even if she'd heard this deep knowledge, she might not have understood.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Yes. It seems she has inherited the blood, but not the knowledge... what a miscalculation. There can be no contest like this.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Ah, yes. So, before Alice left, did she tell you about a fifty-year agreement, and about a certain box?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Ooh, I know this one! So you're here for that box. I'll look. Wait here!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Hmm... Not this one...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Hmm... Hm... Or this one...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: No, no, it's not this one either...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Ah! I remember now. I buried it together with my new treasure, at <color=#00E1FFFF>Windrise</color>!

choices.text: It's a bomb again, isn't it?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Wait for me. I'll be right back!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Klee, don't just run off! Don't you need the things in your pack?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I'll help her pack these things back in. You go after her.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: *sigh* Looking at how rash she is, I worry for the box...

choices.text: Why do you always bury important things outdoors?
See, I said this was a mistake.
There must be some mistake!
I haven't had a chance to look yet.
I can't read the stars...

talks.objective: Talk to Mona, prepare to meet the successor
Catch up with Klee and retrieve the box

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Found it! It's this box.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Glad it wasn't damaged in the explosions.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Retrieval complete! Let's bring it back!

talks.objective: Talk to Klee and retrieve the box

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: We're heeere! This is it. Let's dig it up!

choices.text: This has to be the work of Dendro Slimes.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: It can't be. I put up a sign here. There's no mistake—

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Argh! Dendro Slimes!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yup. Dendro Slimes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* We can talk later, let's take them out first!

choices.text: Dendro Slimes must have done this.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: About Mona's background and her quandary...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I see. I understand the situation.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: There is a <color=#00E1FFFF>magic laboratory</color> in Mondstadt that has been sealed by some unknown person.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Although we have a few specialists who could break the seal, they all have their own labs, and aren't that interested in the matter.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I believe that if the astrologist you mentioned can break the seal, the owner of that house wouldn't mind if she stayed there.

choices.text: I think she can do it.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Alright. Then, allow me to tell you where the house is.

choices.text: I'll take her to go have a look.

talks.objective: Talk to Klee and retrieve the box
Accompany Klee to return the box to Mona

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: You're back at last. The wait was exceedingly dull.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I had intended to read a book to pass the time, but this one was just some ridiculous diary. Nothing of note in it at all.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: It dropped from Klee's backpack, so I thought it might contain some ancient knowledge, but...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Never mind that. So, did you find the box?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: We did. It's in perfect shape!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: That's wonderful— Wait a moment... Wh—Why isn't it locked!? And... why is it empty!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ehhh!?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Well... it's because I borrowed this box to store my treasures.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Borrowed!?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: But since you're here for the box, I took all my treasures out. That's why it's empty.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: You used it to store your things!? Th—Then where are the original contents of the box? That's what I want.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oh. You want the thing that used to be in the box? ...You should've said so.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: You haven't... broken it, have you?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: No! It's not broken at all!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Phew...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: It's the book in your hand.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Whaaaaaaat—!?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Th—This... So this book, this diary... is that hag's... It's her diary from 50 years ago!?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: The thing she wanted back after 50 years was the dark history of her youth?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm finished! No wonder... No wonder that old woman said that I should not look at it no matter what, or she'd rip me to shreds...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Am... Am I in trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Ah! It was you who said you wanted the box. You didn't say anything about the thing inside!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I don't know anything. I'm leaving! Bye!

choices.text: What a touching conclusion...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm... Well, if you don't say anything, your master won't find out, will she?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Impossible. Astrology can see through all lies — you've seen it yourself.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: *sigh* After having spent all my Mora to come to Mondstadt, not only have I gained no knowledge, but now I can't return... How did it come to this...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's so sad... Maybe you could forget everything in that book, and then go back?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: That's... too difficult. And even if I wanted to stay in Mondstadt, it would be...

choices.text: Too embarrassing?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Yes. How can I maintain a proper astrologist's mentality if I stay with all these philistines?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, then you'll just have to go back and face your master.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: S—Stop talking about it! I... I guess I'll have to...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I'll just have to stay in Mondstadt temporarily. Once that old crone's reached the end of her days, I'll be free.

choices.text: An intimidating resolution.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: But what will I do about my astrology research? ...No, wait, I don't even have a place to stay.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: About that, we can go ask <color=#00E1FFFF>Katheryne at the Adventurers' Guild</color>. Let's see if she can help.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: The Adventurers' Guild? Ah, right, you can do commissions for them in exchange for... you know what I mean, don't you?

choices.text: Of course.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Oh. Um, thanks. I... Never mind, it's nothing.

choices.text: That was always the plan.
Does that really count as "temporary"?
Too expensive?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Yes— I mean, no! You really have no way with words.

choices.text: There's no point getting mad at Klee.

talks.objective: Speak to Katheryne and help Mona find a place to stay
Head to the magical laboratory and check the seal

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: The person who placed this seal... is by no means simple. Breaking this seal by force is nigh on impossible.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Interesting. I suppose it's worth using my astrology on.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Let me see... Hmm, I see, so if you first... ...and then you...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Alright, it's open.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Holy moly, that's amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now we just need to go back to Katheryne, and you'll be able to stay here!

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: No need, no need, you have my utmost thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: You are...?

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm Goth, the owner of this house. I passed by the Adventurers' Guild a while back, and Katheryne told me about the matter.

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: I never thought this troublesome seal would be dispelled so quickly!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Does that mean I can stay here?

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: Of course, of course. The facilities inside were just being left there, anyway. I would be glad to have someone make use of them.

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: To express my thanks, I shall rent this building to you at the lowest possible price!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: R—Rent?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I didn't hear anything about rent, and I helped out, too...

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: Yes, of course, I understand. I am most thankful to you for that, so rest assured that I will give you the best rates!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I... I mean...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks Mona's misunderstood something, but...

choices.text: This might be her best option.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: *sigh* I guess I don't have any other choice. I'll rent this place.

response.speaker: Goth
response.text: Great! Then we are agreed. I will go prepare the documentation, please wait here.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Thanks for your help. Also, well, I'm very sorry, but I won't be able to do what I agreed to help you with just yet.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Without the necessary tools, and without new knowledge, it will take me some time to see your destiny clearly.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: But I promise that I'll do a reading for you first thing once I'm ready!

choices.text: As you said, this journey was all gain and no loss.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Thank you. Our traveling together was fate — and of the good kind, I'd say.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I wish you both safe travels! As for me... I need to think of the future as well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How is she going to make a living if she doesn't use astrology to make money?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe we should come back to check on her once in a while. It would really be bad if she fainted from hunger in there...

choices.text: Guess you've got to keep working at it, then.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Yes... I don't really know what to do, but... I'll do my best.

choices.text: Save a little here, scrimp a little there, and you'll be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: That box is really important to me...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: If anything were to happen to it, I wouldn't be able to report back to that old crone...
